pages.text: A Nether $(l)mount$(). Tame it with $(item)Fire Berries$(), put a $(item)Saddle$() on it and ride it. It walks on lava and runs even faster on basalt and blackstone.

A tamed lizard is more than a mount:$(li)$(l)Scent$(): now and then it sniffs out $(item)Ancient Debris$() (first) or $(item)Onyx Ore$() within 14 blocks and shows the way with a trail of sparks.$(li)$(l)Fireproof rider$(): while you ride it you cannot burn, even across lava lakes.$(li)$(l)Molting$(): it sometimes drops a $(item)Magma Shell$().
